tomato_early_blight.cause: Fungus Alternaria solani, favored by warm, humid conditions
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves
Apply neem oil spray every 7 days
chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil-based fungicide as per label dosage
prevention: Crop rotation (avoid tomato/potato in same spot for 2 years)
Mulch to prevent soil splash onto leaves

organic_treatment: Drain and dry the field intermittently to reduce humidity
Apply well-decomposed compost to strengthen plant resistance
prevention: Use resistant rice varieties where available
